title: Conditional κ = 0.001652760598550299: alternating dissolve/gap-merge owner map on the PR649 gauge44 + PR589 package
body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.001652760598550299** (conservative 0.001652760595670246). This is +2.32×10⁻⁷ over PR649 (0.001652528731617094).

**Change: owner map only.** Code, construction, words, dispatch and bit supplier are exactly PR649's (PR645 gauge44 + PR589 bit supplier). All four reviewed files are byte-identical to the hashes the independent reviewer signed for PR649: assemble.py 1d4449ae, bit_supplier_controls.py e6d33fb6, verify_global.py 16bd5e54, price_profile.py d2f548ad. The other 20 Python files equal PR645's. The new map comes from alternating PR649's dissolve move with gap-merge rounds. `RESULT.json` is now this package's strict replay result, and the independent price receipt was regenerated on this PLAN (PASS, same κ).

## Verification

Local result (Windows, CPython 3.11.11), from a fresh clone of commit c5bf1d01 with no reused artifacts: `verify_manifest.py` PASS (89 files); `reproduce.py --until phases` rebuilt the local supplier from PR635; `verify_global.py` passed invoice, assembly, admission-controls and bit-supplier-controls (12 rejected) and printed **PASS_GAUGE44_NATIVE_EXACT_GLOBAL_ASSEMBLY 0.001652760598550299**.

Reproduce from the repo root at this commit (Python 3.11+, assertions on):

```
git fetch https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds.git a6895a69f8ad98ab45777b03e9e6f48888c39f6f
mkdir -p /tmp/gauge44-pr635 && git archive FETCH_HEAD research/complex-571-cold14-st2 | tar -x -C /tmp/gauge44-pr635
python -B research/gauge44-bit589b/verify_manifest.py
python -B research/gauge44-bit589b/construction/reproduce.py --main . --pr635 /tmp/gauge44-pr635 --out /tmp/gauge44-bit589b-local --until phases
python -B research/gauge44-bit589b/verify_global.py --main . --local /tmp/gauge44-bit589b-local/local --work /tmp/gauge44-bit589b-global
```

Conditional on PR645's premises (all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, normalized wrappers, whole-call hosting, precision/tape, exact-recovery, analytic transfer) and on PR589's bit-supplier assumptions in place of PR543's. No unconditional theorem or Lean certification is claimed.

## Credits

- **icekylinx** (PR645): the gauge44 construction, package and verifier.
- **eumemic and the PR589 authors**: the tuned bit supplier. BitCap's earlier PR589 composition study supplied the derived-deficit checks and controls.
- **vectorsss / Chi Zhao** (PR638): `relocate_two`, generalised by our gap-merge; the dissolve move was introduced in PR649.
- The PR635 lineage and every contributor credited in PR645.
